metadata.xplore:goal: Cartes Outdoor readability without Cartes server data dependencies

xplore:palette.name: muted alpine terrain
xplore:palette.forestHalo: wood halo hue matches opaque Wood fill color
xplore:palette.forestPattern: wood SVG pattern strokes are separate darker marks, not reused by halo layers
xplore:palette.screeRevision: dark scree base with light opaque SVG field and transparent pebble cutouts using evenodd path
xplore:palette.forestFill: Wood fill is opaque; fill-opacity removed
xplore:palette.softEdgeOpacity: landcover soft-edge halos are more opaque

xplore:layer-order.intent: Maputnik-friendly ordering by source-layer and visual subcategory; glow/halo layers are placed at the end of their natural source-layer blocks.
xplore:layer-order.renderRule: MapLibre renders layers in array order, bottom to top. Paired outlines/fills and route outline/fill/dash sequences are preserved.
xplore:layer-order.maputnikGrouping: Maputnik 3 reads per-layer metadata.group as flat groups; nested folders are not represented by the style spec.
